items.title: 1.2 Units ka bain-ul-aqwami nizam (International System of Units) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 1.2 with Tables 1.1 to 1.3 and the sixteen conventions (PDF 5-8).

blocks.text: 1960 mein ek international committee ne physical quantities ko bayan karne ke liye kuch definitions aur standards par ittefaq kiya. Jo system bana use System International (SI) kehte hain.
SI units duniya bhar ke scientists aur taqreeban sab mulk istemal karte hain. SI mein do qism ke units hain: base units aur derived units.
Base Units

Physical quantities ke saat (7) base units hain: length, mass, time, temperature, electric current, roshni ki shiddat (luminous intensity) aur amount of substance (madde ki miqdar, yani particles ki tadaad ke hawale se). In ke saath milli, micro, kilo waghaira jaise prefixes laga kar chhoti ya bari miqdarein likhi ja sakti hain.
In base units ke naam aur symbols Table 1.1 mein diye gaye hain.
Derived Units
Derived units woh units hain jo base units se bante hain. Kuch derived units Table 1.2 mein hain. Plane angle aur solid angle ke units bhi 1995 se derived units ki list mein shamil hain.
Base aur derived units ke ilawa SI kuch aur units ki bhi ijazat deta hai, jaise:

items: Angle napne ke purane riyazi (mathematical) units: degree, arcminute aur arcsecond.
Waqt ke purane units: minute, hour, day aur year.
Logarithmic unit bel (aur us ke multiples, jaise decibel).
Rozmarra zindagi ke do metric units: volume ke liye litre aur bare masses ke liye tonne (metric ton).
Do non-metric scientific units: atomic mass unit (u) aur electron volt (eV).
Nautical mile aur knot: yeh samandar aur meteorology (mausamiyat) mein istemal hote hain.
Acre aur hectare: zameen ka raqba (area) napne ke units.
Bar: pressure ka unit; meteorology mein millibar aur engineering mein kilobar ki shakal mein istemal hota hai.
Angstrom aur barn: physics aur astronomy mein istemal hone wale units.

blocks.text: Kitab atomic mass unit ka symbol µ (Greek harf mu) chhapti hai. µ to prefix micro ka symbol hai. Atomic mass unit ka sahi symbol u hai.
blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti

blocks.alt: Mass (kg) ka khara scale, upar 10⁻³⁰ se neeche 10³⁰ tak, har paanch das ki taqaton par nishan. Saath upar se neeche: electron, proton, uranium atom, DNA molecule, cell, machhar (mosquito), kitab, car, oil tanker, Mount Everest, Zameen aur Suraj.
blocks.caption: Kuch masses ka order of magnitude (Interesting Information; kitab ke chart ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Is scale par har bara nishan pichhle se 10⁵ guna (ek lakh guna) bhari hai, is liye electron (taqreeban 10⁻³⁰ kg) aur Suraj (taqreeban 2 × 10³⁰ kg) ek hi chart par aa jate hain. Har cheez ka nishan us ke mass ka order of magnitude (10 ki power) batata hai: kitab taqreeban 1 kg = 10⁰ kg, car taqreeban 10³ kg, Zameen taqreeban 6 × 10²⁴ kg.
blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein

blocks.text: Kitab ka chart proton ko 10⁻²⁸ kg ke qareeb dikhata hai. Proton ka asal mass 1.67 × 10⁻²⁷ kg hai, is liye upar diye gaye chart mein use 10⁻²⁷ kg ke paas rakha gaya hai.
blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti

blocks.text: Scientific Notation

Adad (numbers) ek standard shakal mein likhe jate hain jise scientific notation kehte hain; is mein 10 ki powers istemal hoti hain. Qaida yeh hai ke decimal ke baen (left) sirf ek non-zero hindsa ho. Is liye 134.7 ko 1.347 × 10² aur 0.0023 ko 2.3 × 10⁻³ likha jata hai.
Prefixes

Zyada tar prefixes 1000 ke qadmon (steps) mein order of magnitude batate hain. In se bohat bare aur bohat chhote adad aasani se likhe jate hain aur ghair-zaroori (non-significant) hindse hat jate hain. SI se pehle jo prefixes rawaj mein the un mein se chaar SI mein bhi rakhe gaye (Table 1.3): centi (10⁻²), deci (10⁻¹), deka (10¹) aur hecto (10²).

blocks.caption: Table 1.3 Some Prefixes for Powers of Ten

blocks.text: SI units istemal karne ke qawaid (Conventions)
SI units likhte waqt, khas taur par prefixes likhte waqt, ehtiyat chahiye. Yeh nukte yaad rakhein:

items: Har SI unit ka ek symbol hai, abbreviation (mukhtasar lafz) nahi; symbols har zaban mein ek jaise hain, is liye sahi symbol likhna zaroori hai. Misal: ampere ke liye “A”, “amp” nahi; second ke liye “s”, “sec” nahi; SI, S.I. nahi.
Unit ka poora naam capital (bare) harf se shuru nahi hota: newton, metre waghaira; sirf Celsius is se alag hai.
Symbols chhote (lower case) harfon mein hote hain: metre ke liye “m”, second ke liye “s”; litre ka “L” alag hai.
Jo units scientists ke naam par hain un ke symbol ka pehla harf capital hota hai: newton ke liye “N”, pascal ke liye “Pa”, watt ke liye “W”.
Symbols aur prefixes hamesha seedhe (upright, roman) style mein chhapte hain, chahe aas paas ka text tircha (italic) ho. Misal: a distance of 50 m.
Symbols ka plural (jama) nahi banta: 1 mm, 100 mm, 1 kg, 60 kg (kgs nahi).
Symbol ke baad full stop ya nuqta nahi lagta, siwaye jumle ke aakhir ke.
Prefix unit se pehle aur baghair space ke likha jata hai: “mL”, m L nahi; “ms”, m s nahi.
Units ke darmiyan ek space chhorein, aur adad (value) aur symbol ke darmiyan bhi space chhorein: 1 kg, 10 m s⁻¹.
Do prefix ek saath (compound prefix) nahi lagte: 1 µµF ko 1 pF likhein.
Jab prefix wale unit par power lagti hai to power poore multiple par lagti hai, sirf base unit par nahi: 1 km² = 1 (km)² = 1 × (10³ m)² = 1 × 10⁶ m².
Solidus (m/s) ki jagah negative index (m s⁻¹) likhein.
Scientific notation istemal karein, yani decimal ke baen ek non-zero hindsa: 143.7 = 1.437 × 10².
Ek hi expression mein symbol aur naam mila kar na likhein: metre per second ya m s⁻¹ likhein; metre/sec ya m/second nahi.
Practical ki readings us unit mein likhein jo instrument ke liye aasan ho: screw gauge ki readings mm mein, magar aakhri nateeja munasib base units mein.
SI purane CGS system ke units, jaise dyne, erg, gauss, poise, torr (kitab mein “Tor”), ki ijazat nahi deta.

blocks.caption: Kuch time intervals ki taqreebi qeematein (For Your Information)
rows: Dil ki do aam dharkanon ke darmiyan waqt
Sunai dene wali awaz ki lehron ka period
Solid mein atom ki thartharahat (vibration) ka period
Nazar aane wali roshni ki lehron ka period

blocks.text: Mass ko energy ki ek shakal samjha ja sakta hai; dar asal mass bohat ghani (concentrated) energy hai. Einstein ki mashhoor equation E = mc² ka matlab hai: energy = mass × (roshni ki speed)². Is equation ke mutabiq 1 kg mass asal mein 9 × 10¹⁶ J energy ke barabar hai.
blocks.title: Do You Know? (Kya aap jante hain?)

blocks.text: 1 kg × (3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹)² = 9 × 10¹⁶ J. Isi liye nuclear reactions mein thora sa mass khatam hone par bohat zyada energy nikalti hai.
blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein

blocks.prompt: 0.000 000 52 m aur 4 500 000 J ko scientific notation mein munasib prefix ke saath likhein, aur 'a force of 20 Newtons', '5 kgs', '12 m/s' aur '1 mmm' ko qawaid ke mutabiq durust karein.
blocks.explanation: 0.000 000 52 m = 5.2 × 10⁻⁷ m = 0.52 µm (ya 520 nm); 4 500 000 J = 4.5 × 10⁶ J = 4.5 MJ. Unit ka naam chhote harf se aur symbol N: '20 N' ya '20 newton'. Symbol ka plural nahi: '5 kg'. Solidus ki jagah negative index: '12 m s⁻¹'. Compound prefix ki ijazat nahi: 1 mmm (milli-milli-metre) = 1 µm.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: SI (1960): saat base units (m, kg, s, A, K, cd, mol) aur derived units (rad, sr, N, J, W, C, Pa waghaira); kuch izafi units ki bhi ijazat (degree, minute, hour, litre, tonne, u, eV, bar waghaira).
Scientific notation: decimal se pehle sirf ek non-zero hindsa (1.347 × 10²). Prefixes atto (10⁻¹⁸) se exa (10¹⁸) tak, zyada tar 1000 ke qadmon mein; saath centi, deci, deka, hecto.

Solah (16) qawaid: symbol, abbreviation nahi; chhote harf, siwaye scientists ke naam aur L ke; koi plural ya full stop nahi; prefix jura hua; adad aur unit ke darmiyan space; compound prefix nahi; power poore multiple par; m s⁻¹, m/s nahi; naam aur symbol mila kar nahi; CGS units nahi.
